facts.value: Successful completion of a Qualifying Test at CEFR level B2.2.
Preliminary admission for the qualification phase of the bachelor's examination according to §9 paragraph 5.
There is a two-stage application procedure with different deadlines. You must participate in both stages and pass the Online Qualifying Test.
Registration deadline: September 21, 2026 – October 5, 2026 via QIS.
Examination registration and deregistration deadline: October 8, 2026 – October 21, 2026 via QIS.
Students who have the Cambridge Certificate C1, a score of at least 100 points on the TOEFL test, or a score of at least 7.5 on the IELTS test are exempt from the Qualifying Test.
Language proof must be uploaded in PDF format on the Online Qualifying Test English on September 28, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM.
